4 Card Omaha Hi.name: 4 Card Omaha Hi
4 Card Omaha Hi.deal: 4 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
4 Card Omaha Hi.rules: You MUST use exactly 2 cards from your hand and 3 cards from the board.
4 Card Omaha Hi.winner: Best 5-card standard poker hand scoops the entire pot.

4 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.name: 4 Card Omaha Hi-Lo (O8)
4 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.deal: 4 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
4 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.rules: You MUST use exactly 2 cards from your hand and 3 cards from the board. For the low, 8-qualifier.
4 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand and the best qualifying Low hand. If no low qualifies, High scoops.

4 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.name: 4 Card Omaha Double Board Hi
4 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.deal: 4 hole cards dealt to each player; 2 separate community boards dealt simultaneously.
4 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.rules: Must use exactly 2 hole cards and 3 board cards on each board (you may use different hole cards for each board).
4 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand on Board 1 and the best High hand on Board 2.

5 Card Omaha Hi.name: 5 Card Omaha Hi (Big O Hi)
5 Card Omaha Hi.deal: 5 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
5 Card Omaha Hi.rules: You MUST use exactly 2 cards from your hand and 3 cards from the board.
5 Card Omaha Hi.winner: Best 5-card standard poker hand scoops the entire pot.

5 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.name: 5 Card Omaha Hi-Lo (Big O)
5 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.deal: 5 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
5 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.rules: You MUST use exactly 2 cards from your hand and 3 cards from the board for each hand. For the low, 8-qualifier.
5 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand and the best qualifying Low hand. If no low qualifies, High scoops.

5 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.name: 5 Card Omaha Double Board Hi
5 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.deal: 5 hole cards dealt to each player; 2 separate community boards dealt simultaneously.
5 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.rules: Must use exactly 2 hole cards and 3 board cards per board (you may use different hole cards for each board).
5 Card Omaha Double Board Hi.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand on Board 1 and the best High hand on Board 2.

6 Card Omaha Hi.name: 6 Card Omaha Hi
6 Card Omaha Hi.deal: 6 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
6 Card Omaha Hi.rules: You MUST use exactly 2 cards from your hand and 3 cards from the board.
6 Card Omaha Hi.winner: Best 5-card standard poker hand scoops the entire pot.

6 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.name: 6 Card Omaha Hi-Lo
6 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.deal: 6 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
6 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.rules: You MUST use exactly 2 cards from your hand and 3 cards from the board. For the low, 8-qualifier.
6 Card Omaha Hi-Lo.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand and the best qualifying Low hand. If no low qualifies, High scoops.

Crazy Pineapple Double Board.name: Crazy Pineapple Double Board
Crazy Pineapple Double Board.deal: 3 hole cards dealt to each player; 2 separate community boards.
Crazy Pineapple Double Board.rules: After post-flop betting (before the turn), all active players MUST discard 1 hole card, keeping 2. Standard Hold'em rules apply (use 0, 1, or 2 hole cards).
Crazy Pineapple Double Board.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand on Board 1 and the best High hand on Board 2.

Drawmaha.name: Drawmaha (Sviten Special)
Drawmaha.deal: 5 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
Drawmaha.rules: After the flop betting round, active players may discard and draw up to 5 replacement cards. Played simultaneously as 5-card draw (in hand) and Omaha Hi (2 from hand + 3 from board).
Drawmaha.winner: Pot splits 50/50: half to the best 5-Card Draw hand (in hand only), half to the best Omaha Hi hand on board.

Tahoe Double Board.name: Tahoe Double Board
Tahoe Double Board.deal: 3 hole cards dealt to each player; 2 separate community boards.
Tahoe Double Board.rules: Keep all 3 hole cards throughout the hand, but you may use at most 2 hole cards (0, 1, or 2 hole cards) with 3 board cards.
Tahoe Double Board.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand on Board 1 and the best High hand on Board 2.

Tahoe Hi-Lo.name: Tahoe Hi-Lo
Tahoe Hi-Lo.deal: 3 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
Tahoe Hi-Lo.rules: Keep all 3 hole cards throughout the hand, but you may use at most 2 hole cards (0, 1, or 2 hole cards) with board cards. Ace is low for qualifying low hands.
Tahoe Hi-Lo.winner: Pot splits 50/50 between the best High hand and the best qualifying Low hand (8-or-better). If no low qualifies, High scoops.

Irish Poker.name: Irish Poker
Irish Poker.deal: 4 hole cards dealt to each player; 1 community board.
Irish Poker.rules: After post-flop betting (before the turn card is dealt), all active players MUST discard 2 hole cards, keeping 2. Plays out as standard Texas Hold'em thereafter (use 0, 1, or 2 hole cards).
Irish Poker.winner: Best 5-card standard poker hand scoops the entire pot.
